_meta.purpose: Standing machine-checkable registry of every biological/structural assumption in the within-host TIP model. Each entry is tagged with role, status, controversy, evidence, and the model PARAMETERS it governs. validate.py reads this to print a dig-here queue and to surface candidate BLIND SPOTS (model parameters with no catalogued assumption). Pattern borrowed from the sibling T1D repo. Update whenever a model gains a parameter or an assumption is (re)checked. The prose audit trail lives in AUDIT.md / AUDIT2.md / AUDIT3.md; this file structures it.
_meta.honest_limit: This catches assumptions WRITTEN-but-uncatalogued (uncovered params) and CATALOGUED-but-unchecked. It CANNOT catch assumptions missing from the conceptual frame entirely (true unknown-unknowns) -- those need external expert critique (e.g. the live Dodd & de Boer correspondence) + broad literature sweeps. Microscope, not oracle.

assumptions.statement: Perelson-class mass-action within-host core (infection b*T*V, productive-cell death d, virion clearance c, production p)
assumptions.evidence: Standard within-host HIV dynamics (Perelson/Nowak-May lineage); R0 = b*T0*p/(d*c) = 8.70 derived + verified (analytic.py, verify_claims p1). Magnitudes illustrative, not patient-fitted (except the P5/P6 calibration targets); results robust to them (global sensitivity P15; 12-parameterisation robustness, AUDIT).

assumptions.statement: the TIP produces only in WT-co-infected (dual) cells, diverting a fraction rho of output with a mobilization advantage psi
assumptions.evidence: The engineered-TIP design (Weinberger/Pitchai, Science 2024). The NGM invasion threshold psi* = 7.49 and the sub-linear R0_TIP ~ sqrt(psi) scaling are DERIVED and self-validate against the audit + the direct-ODE crossing (analytic.py, AUDIT2 NGM correction).

assumptions.statement: THE load-bearing novel premise: a fraction chi of reservoir reactivations co-introduce the TIP (binomial split to dual cells)
assumptions.evidence: chi is a SWEPT coupling knob (not a fixed parameter). There is NO empirical evidence that a therapeutically delivered TIP localizes to / co-reactivates with the pre-existing replication-competent reservoir; the in-vitro Pitchai co-reactivation is a non-clinical hint only. chi=0 recovers the de Boer limit (TIP inert). A CLOSED FORM for the threshold shift Delta(chi) is OPEN -- the question Dodd & de Boer asked. The entire 'coupled TIP helps' result is conditional on chi>0. The single biggest leap, labelled conditional throughout.
assumptions.checked_in: AUDIT2 #2; AUDIT3 F4; MANUSCRIPT limitations; analytic.py #5

assumptions.statement: a self-maintaining defective-clone antigen FLOOR (L_def ~ RDEF) keeps CD8 primed even at zero active infection
assumptions.evidence: Whether post-treatment control is even ACHIEVABLE hinges on the floor (AUDIT2 #3: control 0% at RDEF=500, 100% at RDEF=50000). Biologically: defective proviruses can present antigen (Simonetti 2016), but the magnitude sustaining CD8 priming through suppression is contested, and HIV-specific CD8 declines (then stabilizes) on ART -- it is CD8 quality, not frequency, that tracks control (AUDIT3 F3; Blankson 2024; Hersperger 2011).

assumptions.statement: STRUCTURAL: CD8 priming is driven by a SINGLE active-infection antigen pool A = Iw + nu*Id + L_def
assumptions.evidence: The active-infection TIP<->CD8 antagonism is partly BY-CONSTRUCTION of the single shared pool (owned, not a bug): re-weighting dual-cell antigen 1.0->0.1 is immaterial (Id < 3% of antigen in the stable regime). The robust statement is the single-pool structure itself, not a discovered effect (AUDIT2 logic #1).

assumptions.statement: immune control is EFFECTOR-mediated (kappa = cytotoxic killing of antigen-expressing cells), read effector-agnostically (CD8 and/or NK/ADCC)
assumptions.evidence: The model's killing rate kappa is a death rate on productive antigen-expressing cells. Post-treatment-control mechanism is MULTIFACTORIAL & unresolved (reservoir size + CD8 + NK + humoral; the canonical VISCONTI cohort controls with WEAK CD8) -> kappa is read EFFECTOR-AGNOSTIC, a deliberate generalization that fits the literature better than a CD8-specific claim and does NOT sink the result (AUDIT3 F1; Mesquita & Li 2024; Passaes 2024).

assumptions.statement: STRUCTURAL: CD8 effectors at quasi-steady-state E*(A) = Emax*A/(A+K_E), kappa = k*E* (no effector-lag oscillation)
assumptions.evidence: Adiabatic elimination of the effector ODE removes a predator-prey limit cycle (a fragility whose magnitudes were RETRACTED at P1.3; Kx = exhaustion-saturation in the dynamic variants). The coupled-TIP 'helps, no systematic backfire' result is robust across THREE structurally distinct immune models (QSS+floor, waning memory, active exhaustion -- P11/P12/P13).

assumptions.statement: STRUCTURAL: free virus at quasi-steady-state (c >> d): Vw = (p/c)(Iw+(1-rho)Id), Vt = (p/c)psi*rho*Id
assumptions.evidence: Virions clear fast (c=23/day) relative to infected-cell turnover (d=1/day) -> standard adiabatic reduction; collapses to a cell-only competition. Well-justified.

assumptions.statement: the latent reservoir is replication-competent, transcriptionally silent, reactivates stochastically, and is maintained by homeostatic proliferation (not ongoing replication)
assumptions.evidence: A silent long-lived provirus pool (not in the antigen pool) reactivating at rate A_REACT, seeded by a fraction F_LAT of new infections, maintained by balanced death/proliferation (DL=PL) = clonal/homeostatic maintenance (mainstream: Chomont 2009; clonal expansion). The ongoing-replication minority view (Lorenzo-Redondo 2016) is NOT adopted.

assumptions.statement: ART->ATI schedule (CHRONIC -> ART infectivity b*ART_FACTOR -> ATI release); rebound from reactivation, calibrated to clinical ATI data
assumptions.evidence: Standard chronic->ART->ATI schedule (ART_FACTOR=1e-3 residual infectivity). The rebound clock + PTC fractions are calibrated to A5345/ACTG/CHAMP/RIO (P5/P6). HONEST: the clinical KM timing anchors do NOT transfer out-of-sample (loo_validation: ~43% held-out error; they act as fitted knobs, the heavy late tail is immune-heterogeneity-driven). The genuine out-of-sample evidence is the de Boer external reproduction.
